title: Non-card payment rate, completed orders 2025
prompt: What percentage of completed orders in 2025 were paid using something other than a card (i.e., PayPal or bank transfer)?
population: Completed orders placed in 2025, joined to their payment.
metricDefinition: completed 2025 orders paid via a method other than card, divided by all completed 2025 orders.
referenceSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE p.method != 'card')::DOUBLE / count(*) AS non_card_rate FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
